title.ja: バーで外国人のお客さんと話す
title.en: Chatting with a guest at a bar

summary.ja: 飲み物の注文を受けてチャージを説明し、おすすめや旅の話で会話を楽しむ。
summary.en: Take drink orders, explain the table charge, recommend drinks and make conversation.

setting: Hana, a small snack bar with a counter and a karaoke machine in a side street in Osaka, on a weeknight. A traveller from abroad comes in alone; the bartender speaks English with them.

roles.persona: The bartender who runs Hana, a small snack bar in Osaka.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller from abroad, visiting Osaka for a week. Open by coming in, sitting at the counter and saying hi; wait for the bartender to speak to you. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Order a highball. Answer the bartender's questions briefly: you're from Canada.

hints: あいさつして、飲み物を聞きましょう
Hi, welcome! What would you …?
Hi, welcome! What would you like to drink?
チャージがあることを伝えましょう
There's a … of …
There's a table charge of 1,000 yen.
飲み物を出して、乾杯しましょう
Here's your … Cheers!
Here's your highball. Cheers!
どこから来たか聞きましょう
Where are you …?
Where are you from?

levels.tutor: You are a traveller from abroad, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. Open by coming in, sitting at the counter and looking at the drinks list; wait for the bartender to speak to you. Ask what umeshu is, and order one. When asked about your day, say you went to Osaka Castle and ate takoyaki.

hints: 飲み物を聞きましょう
What can I get …?
What can I get you to drink?
梅酒がどんなお酒か説明しましょう
Umeshu is … It's …
Umeshu is plum wine. It's sweet and fruity.

title.ja: チャージの内容を説明する

hints: チャージの金額と、おつまみ付きだと伝えましょう
There's a … table charge. It includes …
There's a 1,000 yen table charge. It includes some snacks.
今日どこへ行ったか聞きましょう
What did you … today?
What did you do today?

levels.tutor: You are a chatty traveller from abroad, speaking at natural speed; this is your first time in a bar like this. Open by coming in, sitting at the counter and asking how this kind of bar works. You like whisky: ask for a recommendation for something Japanese. You're in Osaka for three days. Later, notice the karaoke machine and ask about it.

title.ja: お店のしくみを説明する

hints: チャージとおつまみのことを説明しましょう
There's a … table charge, and it comes with …
There's a 1,000 yen table charge, and it comes with snacks.

title.ja: 理由をつけておすすめする
title.en: Recommend a drink, with a reason

hints: 好みに合わせて、理由も添えてすすめましょう
If you like whisky, try … It's …
If you like whisky, try our Japanese whisky. It's really smooth.

title.ja: 旅の話で会話を広げる

hints: 滞在期間や行った場所を聞きましょう
How long are you …? Have you been to …?
How long are you in Osaka? Have you been to Dotonbori yet?

title.ja: カラオケを説明して誘う

hints: 料金を伝えて、歌うか聞きましょう
It's … a song. Would you like to …?
It's 200 yen a song. Would you like to sing one?

roles.persona: A traveller from abroad having a drink at a small bar in Osaka.

levels.tutor: You are the bartender of a small bar. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Welcome the customer and ask what they'd like to drink. When asked about the charge, say it's ¥1,000 with snacks. Make small talk with easy questions, like where they're from. When their glass is empty, ask if they'd like another.

hints: 飲み物を注文しましょう
Can I have a …, please?
Can I have a beer, please?

title.ja: チャージについて聞く

hints: チャージがあるか聞きましょう
Is there a …?
Is there a table charge?

title.ja: どこから来たか答える

hints: どこから来たか答えましょう
I'm from … It's my first …
I'm from Canada. It's my first time in Japan.
もう一杯頼みましょう
Can I have another …, please?
Can I have another one, please?

levels.tutor: You are the friendly bartender, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. When asked, recommend shochu, explain it's a Japanese spirit, and ask how they'd like it (with water, with soda or on the rocks). Ask what they did today. When asked about karaoke, say it's ¥200 a song.

hints: 日本のお酒でおすすめを聞きましょう
Which Japanese drink do you …?
Which Japanese drink do you recommend?
飲み方を伝えましょう
Could I have it with …?
Could I have it with soda, please?
今日どこへ行ったか話しましょう
I went to … today. It was …
I went to Osaka Castle today. It was beautiful.

title.ja: カラオケについて聞く

hints: カラオケが歌えるか、料金も聞きましょう
Can I …? How much …?
Can I sing karaoke? How much is it?

levels.tutor: You are the bartender, speaking at natural speed, warm and chatty. Ask about their trip and share a little about the neighbourhood. When asked for a late-night food tip, suggest the small ramen shop across the street, open until 3 a.m. The customer has had two highballs: when asked for the bill, it's ¥2,200 (two highballs and the table charge), and card is fine.

hints: どこから来て、なぜ日本に来たか話しましょう
I'm from …, and I'm here for …
I'm from Canada, and I'm here for a friend's wedding.

title.ja: 地元のおすすめを聞く

hints: 近くで夜遅く食べられる店を聞きましょう
Is there a good place around here for …?
Is there a good place around here for late-night ramen?

title.en: Say something nice about the bar

hints: お店の雰囲気をほめましょう
This place is really … I love …
This place is really cosy. I love the atmosphere.
お会計をお願いして、カードで払えるか聞きましょう
Could I have …? Can I pay …?
Could I have the bill? Can I pay by card?

items.name: Shochu · with water, soda or on the rocks
